items.title: The dress
items.line: In late February a badly lit photo of a dress split the internet into white and gold or blue and black. Over 10 million tweets in a week. It was blue and black.

items.title: Hotline Bling
items.line: Drake's Hotline Bling video came out on Apple Music on October 19, and the dance got copied everywhere. The single peaked at number 2 on the Hot 100.

items.title: Mad Max: Fury Road
items.line: It opened May 15. George Miller shot it in the Namibian desert with Tom Hardy and Charlize Theron, and it won six Oscars the next February.

items.title: Star Wars: The Force Awakens
items.line: It opened December 18, directed by J. J. Abrams, and ended up around $2.07 billion worldwide. The teaser had been out since November 2014.

items.title: Apple Watch
items.line: It went on sale April 24, with pre-orders from April 10. The gold Edition models ran from $10,000 to $17,000.

items.title: New Horizons at Pluto
items.line: On July 14 the probe passed about 12,500 km above Pluto, after a trip that began on January 19, 2006.
